name: Beelzebub MCP Honeypot
description:
Description:
Introduce Beelzebub, an MCP‑based honeypot framework that enables creating decoy tools to detect prompt injection and malicious agent behavior.

Motivation:
Strengthen the security of LLM workflows by adding a non‑intrusive detection mechanism.
